title: Frontend Engineer (React)
description: Focuses on React components, lifecycle, hooks, state management, and performance.

questions.text: Can you explain the concept of Higher-Order Components (HOC) and how they compare to custom hooks?
What is the purpose of useEffect cleanups, and how do you prevent memory leaks when dealing with web socket subscriptions?
Explain the React reconciliation process and the role of the "key" prop in lists.
How do you implement code-splitting in React using dynamic imports and React.lazy?
Explain how React handles event delegation under the hood.

title: Frontend Proctored (React)
description: Live video proctored interview assessing advanced React architecture, state management, and performance.

questions.text: Explain the differences between client-side rendering (CSR) and static site generation (SSG) in React.
How do you handle routing and code splitting in a complex React SPA?
What are the main differences between custom hooks and the render props pattern?
What are some common security vulnerabilities in React applications and how do you mitigate them?
Explain the concept of compound components in React and give a production example.

title: Backend Engineer (Node/Express)
description: Covers event loop, asynchronous design patterns, RESTful design, and security.

questions.text: What are the pros and cons of using GraphQL over REST for a Node.js backend?
Explain how middleware execution order and flow control works in Express.js.
How do you analyze a heap dump to debug memory leaks in a running Node.js process?
What is your approach to handling transactions and concurrent updates in databases like MongoDB or PostgreSQL?
What is the purpose of the cluster module and how does it scale applications across CPU cores?

title: HR & Behavioral Round
description: General HR behavioral questions assessing cultural fit, conflict resolution, and leadership.

questions.text: How do you handle feedback or criticism from a peer code review?
Tell me about a time you failed or made a significant mistake. How did you handle the aftermath?
Tell me about a time when you had a conflict with a teammate or manager. How did you resolve it?
Describe a time when you had to explain a complex technical concept to a non-technical stakeholder.
How do you balance technical debt with the pressure to deliver new features quickly?

title: System Architect
description: Advanced systems architecture, scaling databases, caching strategy, microservices, and high-availability designs.

questions.text: Explain the difference between SQL and NoSQL databases. When do you use each architecture?
What are the main differences between event-driven architecture and request-response architecture?
How do you handle API versioning at scale without breaking client implementations?
Design a highly-available, scalable notification system. How do you handle deduping and rate limiting?
Describe your approach to database sharding vs replication. When would you use one over the other?

title: HR Interview
description: General behavioral and cultural fit questions for any role.

questions.text: How do you manage professional pressure and tight production deadlines?
Tell me about a time you handled a difficult situation with a coworker.
Describe a time you showed leadership.
Where do you see yourself in 5 years?
How do you handle differences of opinion when working inside a remote team?

title: Java
description: Technical questions covering core Java, JVM, multithreading, and OOP.

questions.text: What is the difference between an abstract class and an interface?
Explain the difference between final, finally, and finalize keywords in Java.
How does garbage collection work in Java?
Explain the difference between fail-fast and fail-safe iterators in collections.
Explain the difference between JDK, JRE, and JVM.

title: C Programming
description: Core concepts in C including pointers, memory management, and data structures.

questions.text: What is the static keyword used for in C variables and functions?
Explain the differences between a struct and a union in C.
Explain the difference between a macro and an inline function.
What is the purpose of the volatile keyword?
Explain the purpose of the const keyword when used with pointer declarations.

title: Python
description: Python fundamentals, data structures, decorators, and memory management.

questions.text: Explain how exception handling works with try-except-finally blocks.
How is memory managed in Python?
Explain the difference between a list and a tuple in Python.
What is the Global Interpreter Lock (GIL)?
What is the difference between *args and **kwargs in Python function definitions?

title: HTML
description: HTML5 features, semantics, accessibility, and DOM structure.

questions.text: What is the difference between HTML and XHTML?
Explain the difference between local storage, session storage, and cookies.
What is the purpose of the data-* attribute?
Explain the purpose of SVG and Canvas in HTML5.
How do you ensure a webpage is accessible for screen readers?

title: CSS
description: CSS Box Model, layout models (Flexbox/Grid), animations, and responsive design.

questions.text: Explain the difference between absolute, relative, fixed, and sticky positioning.
What are pseudo-classes and pseudo-elements?
How does CSS specificity work?
Describe approaches to making a website responsive without media queries.
What is a media query and how do you write responsive breakpoints?

title: JavaScript
description: Core JS concepts: closures, promises, event loop, and ES6+ features.

questions.text: Explain closures in JavaScript and provide an example of when to use one.
How do Promises work and how do they compare to Async/Await?
Explain the concept of event bubbling and event capturing.
What is the difference between == and ===?
What is the difference between map, filter, and reduce array methods?

title: Web Development
description: General web architecture, REST APIs, HTTP protocols, and security.

questions.text: What happens when you type a URL into a browser and press enter?
What is a RESTful API and what are its core principles?
Explain how you would optimize a website for better performance.
Explain the difference between WebSockets and long polling.
What is DNS and how does it resolve domain names to IP addresses?

title: Authentication
description: OAuth, JWTs, session management, and securing web applications.

questions.text: What is Session hijacking and how do you protect against it?
Explain how JSON Web Tokens (JWT) work.
Explain the difference between OAuth2 and SAML.
What is the difference between authentication and authorization?
What is single sign-on (SSO) and how does it work?
